# create_bot fields

Every field of `POST /api/v1/bots/create_bot`, grouped by feature (78 fields including nested ones). Required fields say **yes**. Guide-only fields that the spec lacks: `whatsapp.account_id` (WhatsApp, beta) and `automatic_leave.call_end_grace_seconds`. `live_video_required` is in the spec but not implemented.

Sources: openapi v1.0.0 a0f050ad. Latest docs: https://docs.meetstream.ai/llms.txt (append `.md` to any page).

## Meeting and identity

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `meeting_link` | string | **yes** | The URL of the Google Meet, Zoom, or Teams meeting. |  |
| `bot_name` | string |  | The display name the bot uses in the meeting. | default `"MeetStream"` |
| `deduplication_key` | string |  | Your own logical key for this bot (printable ASCII, 1-2000 characters). |  |
| `bot_message` | string |  | An initial message for the bot to post in the meeting chat. |  |

| `callback_url` | string |  | A URL to receive webhook event callbacks. |  |

| `custom_attributes` | object |  | Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the bot. |  |

## Platforms and sign-in

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zoom` | object |  | Zoom options. Recommended: set up and configure your own Zoom app (Integrations > Zoom) for reliable, fully supported Zoom bots; meetings outside that app's account need zak_url or obf_url. |  |
| `zoom.use_own_app` | boolean |  | true: require your Zoom app (recommended; 400 without one). false: join without it as an ordinary participant, US region only, no OBF/ZAK and no per-participant camera video. Omitted: your app when one is saved, else the US-only fallback. |  |
| `zoom.zak_url` | string |  | HTTPS mint URL returning a ZAK to join as a signed-in Zoom user. |  |
| `zoom.obf_url` | string |  | HTTPS mint URL returning a fresh, single-use OBF token at join time. |  |
| `google_meet` | object |  | Join Google Meet signed in, as an account on a Google Workspace domain registered through the Google login endpoints. |  |
| `google_meet.login_required` | boolean |  | Set true to request a signed-in join. |  |
| `google_meet.google_login_domain` | string |  | The registered Google Workspace domain. |  |
| `google_meet.sign_in_email` | string |  | Pin the join to one registered account instead of any available one. |  |
| `google_meet.strict_email` | boolean |  | With sign_in_email, true fails if that account is busy or unhealthy; false falls back to another available account on the domain. | default `true` |
| `teams` | object |  | Join Microsoft Teams signed in, as a Microsoft 365 account on a domain registered through the Teams login endpoints. |  |
| `teams.login_required` | boolean |  | Set true to request a signed-in join. |  |
| `teams.teams_login_domain` | string |  | The registered Teams login domain. |  |
| `teams.sign_in_email` | string |  | Pin the join to one registered account. |  |
| `teams.strict_email` | boolean |  | With sign_in_email, true returns 409 if that account is busy or deactivated; false falls back to another available account. | default `true` |
